title: HiCal: Offline Calibration for Hierarchical Scale Encoding in Accurate HiF4 Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2611.32624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Block floating-point (BFP) quantization is widely adopted for efficient low-bit large language model (LLM) inference, where the choice of block scales plays a critical role in quantization accuracy. HiFloat4 (HiF4) employs a hierarchical scale encoding scheme consisting of a global E6M2 scale and two levels of binary scale extensions. However, its conventional rounding rule and fixed scale extension thresholds may not fully capture the statistical characteristics of the quantized tensors in practice, leading to suboptimal scale representations. In this work, we propose HiCal, an offline calibration approach that improves HiF4 quantization accuracy by refining the encoding decisions across all three scale levels. Specifically, we introduce a calibrated rounding bias for the Level-1 E6M2 scale and optimize the scale-extension thresholds at Levels 2 and 3 based on the empirical distributions of local group magnitudes. translated_title: HiCal：面向精确HiF4量化的分层尺度编码离线校准方法
translated_abstract: 块浮点（BFP）量化被广泛应用于高效低比特大语言模型（LLM）推理，其中块尺度的选择对量化精度起着至关重要的作用。HiFloat4（HiF4）采用了一种分层尺度编码方案，由全局E6M2尺度和两级二进制尺度扩展组成。然而，其传统的舍入规则和固定的尺度扩展阈值可能无法充分捕捉实际中量化张量的统计特性，从而导致次优的尺度表示。在这项工作中，我们提出了HiCal，这是一种离线校准方法，通过细化所有三个尺度级别的编码决策来提升HiF4量化精度。具体而言，我们为Level-1的E6M2尺度引入了校准舍入偏置，并基于局部组幅值的经验分布优化了Level 2和Level 3的尺度扩展阈值。由此产生的校准……
tldr: 提出HiCal离线校准方法，通过为E6M2尺度引入校准舍入偏置、并基于局部组幅值经验分布优化尺度扩展阈值，从三个尺度级别全面提升HiF4分层量化精度。
en_tdlr: HiCal is an offline calibration method that improves HiF4 quantization accuracy by introducing a calibrated rounding bias for the E6M2 scale and optimizing scale-extension thresholds at the lower levels based on empirical distributions of local group magnitudes.
